exposure: Women who died between 3 and 24 hours of delivery
Women who died within 3 hours of delivery
cohort: 20,060 women aged 16 years or older diagnosed with postpartum haemorrhage following vaginal or caesarean delivery in 21 countries.
finding: Blood loss was the leading cause of death in women from Africa and Asia, highlighting the need to address late presentation due to births outside of hospitals and the lack of blood for transfusion.
